summaryVi: nevertheless, whereas, hence, moreover, in spite of / despite + N/V-ing — nối ý trang trọng, văn viết.

sections.title: Một số liên từ B2
cells: It was raining; nevertheless, we went out.
She loves cities, whereas he prefers the countryside.
The plan is cheap; moreover, it is effective.
Despite the rain, the event continued.
The evidence was weak; hence, they acquitted him.

items.wrong: Despite of the cost, we bought it.
items.right: Despite the cost, we bought it.
items.noteVi: Despite / in spite of, không despite of.

items.wrong: Although she was tired, but she kept working.
items.right: Although she was tired, she kept working.
items.noteVi: Không dùng although và but cùng lúc.

exercises.prompt: The salary is low; ___, many people apply for the job.
He enjoys team sports, ___ she prefers individual activities.
___ the heavy traffic, we arrived on time.
The data is incomplete; ___, we cannot draw a firm conclusion.
___ (despite / be) tired, she finished the presentation.

exercises.promptVi: Dự án tiết kiệm chi phí; hơn nữa, nó thân thiện môi trường.
exercises.answer: The project saves costs; moreover, it is eco-friendly.

options: Whereas he is shy, but she is outgoing.
He is shy, whereas she is outgoing.
Whereas he is shy, she is outgoing however.
exercises.answer: He is shy, whereas she is outgoing.

exercises.source: Even though it was cold, we swam in the sea.
exercises.answer: Despite the cold, we swam in the sea.

exercises.prompt: The company failed to meet targets; ___, the CEO resigned.

exercises.promptVi: Tôi thích làm việc sáng; trong khi đó, đồng nghiệp tôi là cú đêm.
exercises.answer: I like working in the morning, whereas my colleague is a night owl.
